x: Mike Webb was followed by a very strong looking Adam Jones in the early sixties, but came an ashen Junior Galley and miserable looking Mark Anderson both no doubt thinking of the track but both hanging on well to bring all our scorers inside the top hundred for the first time this season.
The first place team prize along with Paul Evans, Gary Staines and Junior Galley was at least some compensation for sticking it out but Jim was left ill and deflated for several weeks after the race.
